body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sinjimoru expects to unveil its integrated cassette adapter model 'iDeck' at upcoming CES 2009.
iDeck is cassette adapter with maximized convenience through cassette deck, which integrates all the mounting, powering and palying functions for portable products such as iPod.
It is usable for the most of cars that equipped cassette deck and supports iPod 5G, iPod Classic, iPod Touch, iPod Nano and iPhone.
